purpose: Strengthen the local Vivo X80 gray storyboard before any human AI finish.
userApproval: Ah okay sige approved. G! Amaze me!
approvedRevision: Shorter setup; two distinct failed attempts with the second visibly overconfident; owner effortlessly unlocks; friend's caught/deflated reaction earns the punchline; short in-hand X80 hero.

timeline.beat: Owner notices and phone is offered back

success: An independent viewer can distinguish both attempts and explain the visual punchline without reading the shot slates. Screen lock/success and the final product remain unobstructed; actual clips decode to360frames/24fps/15.000s.
failure: Same gesture repeated twice with no escalation, generic reaction, unclear owner/phone identity, hidden screen proof, frozen shots or broken geometry.
evidence: Authored shot/action manifest; key performance stills plus boundary frames; independent sampled storyboard critique; actual encoded contact sheet; complete FFmpeg decode and local browser playback. Full motion taste must be distinguished from sampled inspection.
benchmarkLimit: Apple source was sampled at ten timestamps. Neither a readable storyboard nor still-image critique proves equal finished-video quality.
